# Case 4: Hyperbolic Brownian Motion of Gaussians
# ===============================================
# Brownian motion generated by half the Laplace-Beltrami operator of the Gaussian
# manifold. In the half-plane chart the driftless Ito system dx = y dW1,
# d(log y) = dW2 - (1/2) dt keeps sigma strictly positive. The mean of sigma is a
# martingale while E[log sigma] drifts down, and paths escape to the boundary at
# a linear rate in Fisher-Rao distance.

scenario_name = Case 4 - Hyperbolic Diffusion
case_type = hyperbolic_diffusion

# Simulation
mu0 = 0.0
sigma0 = 1.0
n_walkers = 400
substeps = 6
dt = 0.01

# Parallelism and output
n_cores = 0
output_dir = outputs
save_netcdf = true
save_csv = true
save_animation = true
save_diagnostics = true

# Animation
n_frames = 120
fps = 30
dpi = 150
colormap = jl_ember
marker_size = 7
alpha = 0.8
seed = 42
